note: Chippewa NF campground on Mosomo Point, a wooded point in red and white pine between Little and Big Cut Foot Sioux Lakes (next to Lake Winnibigoshish), 19 mi N of Deer River off Hwy 46. A sheltered cove for boats and paddling; boat access just down the road and a fishing pier on the way in; Cut Foot Sioux Visitor Center half a mile away. --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov/RIDB read: 22 public back-in sites + host site, driveways 35-90 ft (rec.gov RV limit 45 ft, 35 on site 20), 13 reservable 4+ days out, $16 in 2026 and 2027, May 7 - Oct 31, vault toilets, fish-cleaning station; FS says no potable water but rec.gov lists hand pumps. Lakefront kept on rec.gov's per-site flag plus site photos for 13 and 15.
flags: WATERFRONT lakefront kept, on sites 13 (47.517612,-94.048677) and 15 (47.517888,-94.048762), both reservable by the night: rec.gov per-site 'Proximity to Water: Lakefront' (also on 06), and the rec.gov site photos show an open grass apron under scattered pines running to a reed fringe and open water. On Esri imagery the open water of Little Cut Foot Sioux is about 40-45 m west of both points. Site 06 (47.517645,-94.047437) is also flagged Lakefront, but its photo shows only woods and no water; it does not support the value.
